description: Every article on the PMA supplement must be authorized by the assist letter or STC, and the item count must reconcile.
findingText: The number of articles on the PMA supplement does not reconcile with the articles authorized by the assist letter or STC. This includes duplicated supplement rows.
resolutionHint: Compare the supplement line items against the assist letter table; remove duplicates and add any missing authorized article.
limitations: Reconciles counts and part numbers; it cannot judge whether an article should have been included commercially.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
